header: Praxis, for two to five practitioners
subheader: For one treatment address. About seven in ten Talbrunn practices use it.
bodytext:
With up to five practitioners, the whole day fits in one appointment book, and reception is often done by someone who also treats patients. Praxis covers billing, documentation and reminders in one place, with no list of modules to choose from.

You are not tied in. If you outgrow the plan, you can move to Verbund from one month to the next and pay the difference pro rata. If your practice gets smaller, you can move down at the end of a billing period.
note: Net price, plus 20% VAT. Includes one address, five practitioner accounts and unlimited reception accounts.

features.title: Appointment book
features.text: One calendar per practitioner, plus rooms and equipment.

features.title: Reception accounts
features.text: Free for everyone who books and checks in patients.

features.title: Insurance billing
features.text: Claims go out on the first working day of the month.

features.title: Private invoices and receipts
features.text: With your logo and your bank details.

features.title: Treatment documentation
features.text: Findings and reports from your own templates.

features.title: Document storage
features.text: Reports, scans and signed consent forms.

features.title: Data export
features.text: CSV and PDF, without having to ask us.

features.title: Support by phone and email
features.text: From 8:00 to 17:00, answered by our own team.

features.title: Second address
features.text: €25 per month for each further address.
